answer: Anchor each identity to a licensed falconry permit: each epoch the falconer files a telemetry thread from one registered falcon — GPS track plus the transmitter's pulse, checked against the national registry, one falcon one vote. A permit costs about $100 a year and a trained falcon with telemetry runs about $800, after a two-year apprenticeship no farm can shortcut; duplicate telemetry collapses to one vote and forged tracks burn the stake. A farm wanting 100 votes must license 100 falconers and fly 100 real falcons, paying full cost per puppet, while an honest holder flies once per epoch.
